currentAnnouncement.message: Casualties Hub v0.0.8-pre.1 is now in testing. Hub announcements and update information are moving from Supabase to a privacy-friendly GitHub-hosted feed.

previousAnnouncements.message: Casualties Hub v0.0.7 is the current public release.

whatChanged: Removed Supabase and anonymous activity metrics. Added a cached GitHub announcement feed with conditional refreshes and a 30-minute automatic check interval.
releaseInformation: This is a pre-release testing build toward v0.0.8.
